summary: End-to-end testing of FlowPilot Conversation Intelligence (CallMiner-style) replacement of Copilot. 29/29 new insights backend tests + 75/75 regression tests pass (104/104 total). Frontend smoke verified all 4 new pages (Explorer, Categories, Scorecard, Trends) render, sidebar RBAC works (supervisor sees 11 nav items, agent sees 8 — Categories/Supervisor/Users hidden), Copilot fully removed (no panel, /api/copilot/* returns 404, no Ask Copilot trigger). Auto-tagging verified live: a fresh call mentioning 'refund' + 'cancel' was end-called and the categories[] correctly contained both seed category ids. Custom-category create→tag→delete pull-from-calls cycle verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: insights.py:210 — explorer search loads up to 2000 calls into memory then filters in Python (no Mongo $text index). At ~5k+ calls this becomes the dominant latency. Add a text index on calls.transcript.text plus a $text $search prefilter; keep python scoring only for snippet ranking.
insights.py:189 recompute_categories — iterates and does N individual update_one() round-trips. For 5k calls this is 5k round-trips. Switch to bulk_write with UpdateOne ops batched at ~500/batch.

insights.py:281 agent_scorecard for an unknown agent returns 200 with calls[0].agent_name fallback. If an attacker/agent passes a non-existent agent_id that happens to match their own id (they can't), no risk; but supervisors querying a stale/deleted agent will see a synthetic stub. Consider 404 when no user AND no calls.

insights.py:152 PATCH /categories/{id} accepts any color string — no hex validation. A malicious payload (e.g. 'javascript:alert') could pollute the DB and surface unsanitized in the color swatch style attribute. Add a `^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$` Pydantic validator on `color`.
insights.py:440 _duration_sec swallows all exceptions silently — fine for resilience but should log at debug level so corrupt date data isn't invisible.
Categories editor modal has no SheetDescription / DialogDescription — Radix logs the same a11y warning that was flagged in iter4. Add a sr-only description for screen readers.
Explorer filter rail does not show active-filter chips/clear-individual — only a global 'Clear filters'. UX nit at scale (8+ categories selected = no visibility).
